description: Implementation of MessageSourceService for managing message sources and localization in OpenMRS, including setting active message sources, retrieving messages, and managing message presentations.

classes.name: MessageSourceServiceImpl
classes.description: Extensible implementation of MessageSourceService that manages message sources, allows switching active sources, and retrieves localized messages, supporting integration with Spring and OpenMRS contexts.

methods.name: getMessage(String)
methods.description: Retrieves a message string for the given key using the current message source and locale.

methods.name: getActiveMessageSource()
methods.description: Returns the currently active message source.

methods.name: setActiveMessageSource(MutableMessageSource)
methods.description: Sets the active message source and adds it to the available sources.

methods.name: getLocales()
methods.description: Retrieves all locales supported by the active message source.

methods.name: getPresentations()
methods.description: Returns all message presentations available in the active message source.

methods.name: getMessage(MessageSourceResolvable, Locale)
methods.description: Resolves messages based on a MessageSourceResolvable object and locale.

methods.name: getMessage(String, Object[], Locale)
methods.description: Returns a localized message for the given code, arguments, and locale, or blank if code is empty.

methods.name: getMessage(String, Object[], String, Locale)
methods.description: Returns a localized message with a default message fallback.

methods.name: addPresentation(PresentationMessage)
methods.description: Adds a new presentation message to the active message source.

methods.name: removePresentation(PresentationMessage)
methods.description: Removes a presentation message from the active message source.

methods.name: getMessageSources()
methods.description: Returns the set of all available message sources.

methods.name: setMessageSources(Set<MutableMessageSource>)
methods.description: Adds multiple message sources to the available sources.

methods.name: merge(MutableMessageSource, boolean)
methods.description: Merges messages from another message source into the active one, with option to overwrite existing messages.

methods.name: getPresentation(String, Locale)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific presentation message for a given key and locale.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale(Locale)
methods.description: Gets all presentation messages for a specific locale.

methods.name: getParentMessageSource()
methods.description: Returns the parent message source if any.
